items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Frobus Band used to play there. Frobus? Frobus. I believe I told you about that.

ctx.x: Do you remember the names of any of the bands that played out at this Southern Park?

Southern Park? Uh huh. Well, Frobus Band used to play there. Frobus? Frobus. I believe I told you about that. The family pretty near layout. Well, I didn't hear. You didn't tell me about that. The whole family played? Well, you see that the older folks got married and they had children and they taught them children to play music. And when they did get big enough to play, it was a common thing for them to be playing out at Woodrow Gordon or Washington Gordon for different people that hired bands, you see. And they…
Yes. Press Street. Yes. I was going to ask you about a couple more parks. Sportsman's Park. Do you remember that?
